name: wait_for_object_resources

stack.evidence: func_001D3118 takes no stack values and returns scheduler state 4 while the object-resource load flag is set or state 2 when loading is complete

notes: func_001D3118 tests bit 45 (0x0000200000000000) in the shared asynchronous-load state at D_003854E0+0x3070. func_001D30B0 sets that bit when command 181 starts an object resource load, and the load-completion path clears it. The 23 JP calls occur as zero-argument polling waits.
